resources.string: Write what happened and send it privately to Sofaly
Write what happened (the keyboard microphone works too) and send. It goes privately to Sofaly, never to a public page. Your name, account, network and city are not included.
This TV already sent 5 reports today. Try again tomorrow.

Or by e-mail: point your phone camera at the code.
